basic_profile.bio: I'm a college student from Austin, Texas, juggling studies in sports medicine while passionately following K-pop, especially ENHYPEN. I discovered Reddit to connect with fellow fans and learn more about my interests, particularly athlete health and wellness. I usually browse Reddit during evenings and weekends. Single and enjoying the freedom to explore diverse hobbies, including softball and music.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational knowledge of sports medicine from my college courses, and I'm an avid K-pop fan, learning through fan communities and social media. I also engage in self-study on topics related to athlete injuries and health.
